en: The queue is ordered by lane, disposition, risk (low, medium, high, as above), how many other ready or refreshable pull requests it overlaps (fewer first, because landing it invalidates less), how many open pull requests declare that they wait for it and are not yet satisfied (more first, because landing it unblocks them), how many authored paths it changes (fewer first: a smaller change is cheaper to land and to undo), age (older first, so new easy work cannot starve old work) and number. Every key is a value of the assessment or of the queue around it, so the order is total and does not depend on the order the forge listed them; <t1/> proves this as a property. Each assessment carries the factors it was ranked by (<t2/>), and <t3/> prints them, so a rank is never a number without its reasons.
cs: Fronta je řazena podle lane, dispozice, rizika (nízké, střední, vysoké, jak je uvedeno výše), počtu jiných připravených nebo obnovitelných pull requestů, se kterými se překrývá (méně je dřív, protože jeho landing zneplatní méně), počtu otevřených pull requestů, které deklarují, že na něj čekají a ještě nejsou splněné (víc je dřív, protože jeho landing je odblokuje), počtu autorských cest, které mění (méně je dřív: menší změnu je levnější přistát i vrátit), stáří (starší dřív, aby nová snadná práce nemohla vyhladovět starou) a čísla. Každý klíč je hodnota posouzení nebo fronty kolem něj, takže pořadí je úplné a nezávisí na pořadí, v jakém je forge vypsal; <t1/> to dokazuje jako vlastnost. Now is every open milestone holding an open issue with an open pull request that names it (`plan.delivery`'s `pr_open`), a live mesh claim made for it, or a declared ACTIVE status, each with those issues, why they are in flight, their declared status beside their inferred stage, and the objects that prove it (branch, pull request, merge commit, release tag, published `latest.json`, claim), linked on the forge where the forge has them. Next is the first open milestone in the plan's order that is not now and whose unfinished prerequisites are all now. The latest release is the highest stable version among the release records, the `v*` tags of this clone and the `latest.json` the last successful Pages deployment published, so a release whose record merged after its tag is not shown older than it is; `executable_tagged` says whether the answering executable's own version is tagged. `milestone` adds that milestone with every one of its issues. A source that was not read (the forge, the publication, the mesh outside a server) is named with its reason, never treated as empty.

en: Readiness (apps/majordomus-cli/src/capability/builtin/health.rs:<n1/>, GET /api/v1/ready) checks a non-empty registry and that the code is not replaced; a degraded index stays ready:true with layer: warn, and mesh state and lease loss are absent: was_lost() reaches only GET / through LEASEHOLDER_KEY (apps/majordomus-cli/src/http/router.rs:<n2/>). health.report (apps/majordomus-cli/src/capability/builtin/health.rs:<n3/>) has no mesh and no policy-allowed dimension; mesh health lives only in mesh.status, mesh doctor and mesh verify. Running, ready, mesh-healthy and degraded are split across /live, /ready, server.standing_at (apps/majordomus-cli/src/capability/builtin/server.rs:<n4/>), MeshStatus, index::State::Degraded (apps/majordomus-cli/src/index.rs:<n5/>) and LinkState::Degraded (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/cooperation.rs:<n6/>). The top-level majordomus doctor is a governance doctor (lib/doctor.sh:53-77) that checks nothing about the server, the lease or the mesh, which its name suggests it does. Baseline audit of 2026-10-09 at master 1fb8d6be44, failure gap <n7/> and premise <n8/>.
cs: Readiness (apps/majordomus-cli/src/capability/builtin/health.rs:<n1/>, GET /api/v1/ready) kontroluje neprázdný registr a to, že kód nebyl nahrazen; degradovaný index zůstává ready:true s layer: warn a stav mesh a ztráta lease chybí: was_lost() dosáhne jen na GET / přes LEASEHOLDER_KEY (apps/majordomus-cli/src/http/router.rs:<n2/>). health.report (apps/majordomus-cli/src/capability/builtin/health.rs:<n3/>) nemá dimenzi mesh ani dimenzi povolenou politikou; zdraví mesh žije jen v mesh.status, mesh doctor a mesh verify. Běžící, připravený, zdravý v mesh a degradovaný jsou rozděleny mezi /live, /ready, server.standing_at (apps/majordomus-cli/src/capability/builtin/server.rs:<n4/>), MeshStatus, index::State::Degraded (apps/majordomus-cli/src/index.rs:<n5/>) a LinkState::Degraded (apps/majordomus-cli/src/mesh/cooperation.rs:<n6/>). Nejvyšší majordomus doctor je governance doctor (lib/doctor.sh:53-77), který nekontroluje nic o serveru, lease ani mesh, ačkoli to jeho název naznačuje. Audit základní linie ze dne 2026-10-09 na masteru 1fb8d6be44, mezera selhání <n7/> a předpoklad <n8/>.

en: apps/majordomus-cli/src/evidence/subject.rs reads the first '# majordomus-covers:' and the first '# majordomus-negative:' line of every case (module doc at :<n1/>, NEGATIVE const at :<n2/>). apps/majordomus-cli/src/rules/mod.rs builds rule proof from named, present, recorded cases, and RuleState has no notion of a refusal. No case carries a refutes header. .ai/repo/rule-proof-baseline.txt holds only its header. The number of blocking rules is read with majordomus-cli rules report --format json, not quoted here.
cs: apps/majordomus-cli/src/evidence/subject.rs čte první řádek „# majordomus-covers:“ a první řádek „# majordomus-negative:“ každého případu (dokumentace modulu na :<n1/>, konstanta NEGATIVE na :<n2/>). apps/majordomus-cli/src/rules/mod.rs staví důkaz pravidla z pojmenovaných, přítomných, zaznamenaných případů a RuleState nezná pojem odmítnutí. Žádný případ nenese hlavičku refutes. .ai/repo/rule-proof-baseline.txt drží jen svou hlavičku. Počet blokujících pravidel se čte pomocí majordomus-cli rules report --format json, zde se necituje.
